finding: CF-B25-IS-BOWMANS-BEST-NOT-A-CPA-RUNG (2026-09-26, supersedes closed PR #2425). 297 card_catalog rows carry sport=baseball, year=2025, setKey='bowman', cardNumber B25-* (97 distinct numbers), all exploded from actual sales (source catalog-explode-actuals-2026-08-12, plus its graded-child variant and ingest-auto-seed-graded), never from a checklist. checklistinsider's pages for 2025 Bowman flagship, 2025 Bowman Chrome and 2025 Bowman Draft confirm NONE of the three uses a B25- prefix anywhere in their own checklists -- B25- belongs exclusively to 2025 Bowman's Best's "Best of 2025 Autographs" insert (131-card autograph insert). All 1,252 bowman:b25-* sold_comps sales carry titles reading "2025 Bowman's Best Baseball #B25-XXX <parallel>" (CardHedge's own title field), confirming the product. PR #2425 (closed 2026-09-25) proposed the same bowman-to-bowmans-best re-key but was rejected because it moved these 297 rows verbatim -- Refractor /499 and Purple Refractor /250 are NOT Bowman's Best print runs; they are the classic Bowman Chrome / Bowman Draft "Chrome Prospect Autographs" (CPA-) rungs, evidently copy-pasted onto a Bowman's Best identity by whatever step minted these rows pre-explosion. The correct destination is Bowman's Best's OWN rung for the same player+cardNumber: Refractor unnumbered, Purple Refractor /75, Green Refractor /99, Base Autograph un-numbered or per-player numbered (verified against 2,725 checklist-grade bowmans-best B25- auto rows, sources checklistcenter-2026-08-29 / checklistinsider-2026-08-27 / cardhedge-graded). 292 of the 297 rows have such a twin at the exact corrected rung; retiring the phantom-rung row folds pricing onto the twin that was always the real card. The remaining 5 (JoJo Parker's Base Autograph resolved into this list at its true /150 rung; 2 no-auto Base rows for Josuar Gonzalez and Kevin McGonigle with NO checklist-grade twin anywhere; 3 no-auto Base rows for Arnaldo Lantigua, JJ Wetherholt and Chandler Simpson whose only twin lives under a pre-existing split-identity setKey spelling "bowman's-best" with an apostrophe, not this list's target "bowmans-best" -- a separate, already-known defect, out of scope here) are PARKed rather than retired, per the owner's 2026-09-22 ruling that a derived/mint row retires only when a good checklist-grade twin exists at the SAME target setKey; a row with no clean same-setKey twin is parked for the owner rather than retired sight-unseen.
rulings: checklistinsider 2025 Bowman's Best Baseball page: "Best of 2025 Autographs" insert, card number prefix B25-, 131 cards, autograph cards, pack odds 1:7. Parallel ladder for the auto insert observed checklist-grade in card_catalog (2,725 rows, sources checklistcenter-2026-08-29 / checklistinsider-2026-08-27 / cardhedge-graded): Refractor (unnumbered), Purple Refractor /75, Green Refractor /99, Base (auto, un-numbered per most players, numbered per-player for a minority e.g. JoJo Parker /150), plus a full 20-rung colour/printing-plates ladder (Blue Refractor /150, Gold Refractor /50, Gold Mini-Diamond Refractor /50, Teal Refractor /15, Orange Refractor /25, Orange X-Fractor /25, Black Refractor /10, Black X-Fractor /10, Red Refractor /5, Red X-Fractor /5, SuperFractor 1/1, 5x Printing Plates 1/1) not touched by this list.

checklistinsider 2025 Bowman Chrome Baseball page: "Chrome Prospect Autographs" insert, card number prefix CPA- (not B25-), 109 cards; parallel ladder Refractor /499 (1:37 Hobby), Purple Refractor /250 (1:70 Hobby), Green Refractor /99 (1:175 Hobby) -- the exact print-run trio these 297 rows carry, confirming the rung ladder was sourced from Chrome/Draft CPA- and mis-attached to a Bowman's Best B25- identity.

checklistinsider 2025 Bowman Draft Baseball page: also carries a "Chrome Prospect Autographs" insert under its own CPA- prefix (a distinct 109-card pool from Bowman Chrome's); no B25- prefix anywhere in this product either.
checklistinsider 2025 Bowman Baseball (flagship) page: no B25- prefix in any insert; the flagship's own autograph inserts use CPA-, CRA-, BDA-, BPA- and other prefixes.

sold_comps sales (1,252 total at hobbyiqCardId hiq:baseball:2025:bowman:b25-*): CardHedge titles read "2025 Bowman's Best Baseball #B25-XXX <parallel>" verbatim -- these are almost entirely no-auto Base/Refractor/colour-parallel CardHedge listings at OTHER B25- addresses (different cardNumbers / different rung) than the 297 auto rows this list retires; 0/1,252 match any of the 297 rows' exact ids (measured 2026-09-25, unchanged by this list).

131 distinct B25- cardNumbers already live checklist-grade under setKey=bowmans-best (2,725 auto rows + 230 no-auto rows). 97 of those 131 numbers are the ones carried by the 292 rows this list retires; every one has an exact-rung checklist-grade twin once the /499-to-unnumbered, /250-to-/75, and Green-Refractor-to-/99 print-run correction is applied.

Two setKey spellings for the same product coexist in card_catalog for a subset of no-auto rows: 'bowmans-best' (no apostrophe, this list's target and the overwhelming majority) and 'bowman's-best' (with apostrophe) for some cardhedge-graded no-auto rows. This is a separate, pre-existing split-identity defect (out of scope for this list) that blocks 3 of the 5 parked entries from a clean same-setKey retire; it is named here rather than worked around so it is not lost.
